comment: Shared Control/Session Core vector for the model.run.wake payload digest (WS08-S1). The Rust copy goes to apps/Model Plane/rust/services/session-core/tests/fixtures/run-wake-v1.golden.json in WS08-S2. Field order of the digest: org_id, user_id, thread_id, space_id, space_decision_ref, recipient_audience_ref, recipient_audience_hash, privacy_policy_ref, resource_authorization_ref, trigger_message_id, content_digest, agent_subject_id, turn_origin, action_schema_hash, idempotency_key (each name NUL u64-BE-length value), then authority_revision and recipient_audience_revision (name NUL u64-BE). Header model.run.wake NUL v1 NUL. Change the digest only on an intended wire change, on both sides.
